title: Pure Gold Pride
summary: Pure Gold Pride high-speed racing and LP manipulation build, starring eccentric drivers competing across Synchro, Xyz, Link, and Fusion lines. Every racer Special Summons itself from the hand while your LP is lower than your opponent's, intentionally paying LP through searchers to deploy devastating disruptions that tag out in the End Phase.

summary.title: Starters & LP Burn
points: Gold Pride - Better Luck Next Time! searches any Gold Pride monster on activation and inflicts damage equal to its ATK, putting your LP lower than the opponent's and drawing a card whenever a Gold Pride returns to the Extra Deck.

Gold Pride - The Crowd Goes Wild! reveals a Gold Pride monster in hand to search a differently named Gold Pride monster, pays LP equal to the searched monster's ATK, and optionally Special Summons a Gold Pride monster.
Gold Pride - Captain Carrie searches a Gold Pride Trap Card on Normal or Special Summon, and pumps an Extra Deck Gold Pride's ATK from the GY.
Gold Pride - Leon revives a non-Warrior Gold Pride monster from your GY on Normal or Special Summon, and Synchro Summons on the opponent's Main Phase.

summary.title: Opening: Better Luck Next Time! + Captain Carrie
steps: Activate Gold Pride - Better Luck Next Time! to search Gold Pride - Leon and lose 1500 LP (putting your LP below your opponent's).
Special Summon Gold Pride - Captain Carrie from your hand using its lower-LP condition.
Trigger Captain Carrie to search Gold Pride - Start Your Engines! (or Better Luck follow-up) from your Deck.
Normal Summon Gold Pride - Leon to revive Captain Carrie from the GY (or another Gold Pride).
Overlay Captain Carrie and Leon to Xyz Summon Gold Pride - Chariot Carrie; detach 1 material to search a Gold Pride Spell and mill a Gold Pride monster.

summary.title: Quick-Effect Summons & Disruption
points: Gold Pride - Leon acts as a Quick Effect Tuner during the opponent's Main Phase, immediately Synchro Summoning Gold Pride - Star Leon or Eradicator using monsters you control.
Gold Pride - Roller Baller performs a Quick Effect Fusion Summon during either player's Main Phase, using materials from your hand or field to summon Gold Pride - Pin Baller.
Gold Pride - Eliminator banishes a Gold Pride monster from your GY to Special Summon a Gold Pride Token with the same Level, facilitating exact Synchro tuning.
Gold Pride - Nytro Head gives a Nytro Token to the opponent's field, then destroys it along with all adjacent monster and Spell/Trap zones.

summary.title: Bosses & Tag-Outs
points: Gold Pride - Star Leon gains ATK equal to an opponent monster's original ATK and destroys it as a Quick Effect, returning to the Extra Deck in the End Phase to revive Leon.
Gold Pride - Eradicator destroys 1 or 2 cards summoned from the Extra Deck as a Quick Effect and returns to the Extra Deck in the End Phase to revive Eliminator.
Gold Pride - Pin Baller equips up to as many face-up opponent monsters to itself as the number of Fusion Materials used for its summon.
Gold Pride - Nytro Blaster destroys an opponent's monster and all cards in its adjacent zones, returning to the Extra Deck to revive Nytro Head.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Gold Pride - Start Your Engines! destroys a monster when the opponent summons, then Special Summons a Gold Pride monster from your Deck.
Gold Pride - That Came Out of Nowhere! Special Summons a Gold Pride monster from your hand or GY, and can return an opponent's card to hand if they control a monster.
Gold Pride - Pedal to the Metal! grants 1000 ATK and effect immunity to a Gold Pride monster, and Sets itself from the GY in the End Phase.
Gold Pride - It's Neck and Neck! recycles a Gold Pride card and Special Summons a Gold Pride from the Extra Deck when the opponent's monster has ATK higher than your LP.
